name: combat-reviews-flagship-02
objective: Animate the locked ten-panel storyboard into one 15-second internal-review motion proof that preserves its scene order, compositions, headlines and call to action exactly
targetAudience: Combat sports fans aged 18-34 who follow more than one promotion and argue about results after every card

productFacts.label: Coverage
productFacts.detail: Combat Reviews lists events across multiple combat-sports promotions in one app.

productFacts.label: Events screen
productFacts.detail: The events screen shows upcoming fights with predictions, full cards, venues, broadcasters and live countdowns.

productFacts.label: Rankings
productFacts.detail: The product carries fighter rankings alongside the community challenge leaderboard.

productFacts.label: Predictions
productFacts.detail: Points are earned from correct predictions in the CombatReviews Challenge, ranked on a leaderboard by prediction accuracy.

productFacts.label: Free to predict
productFacts.detail: Making a prediction costs nothing. The CombatReviews Challenge is skill, not betting, and takes no stakes.

productFacts.label: Discussion
productFacts.detail: Each event carries a card-talk discussion region where fans talk about the card.

productFacts.label: How it is opened
productFacts.detail: Combat Reviews is reached on the web. There is no verified public App Store or Google Play listing, so no store badge and no download promise may appear.

productFacts.label: Prediction state
productFacts.detail: No available evidence shows the product locks a prediction at submission, so the cut says only that a prediction was submitted.

keyMessages: Every fight, from every combat sport, in one place
Research the division, read the matchup, then make a free prediction
Correct predictions build a record, and the argument carries on afterwards
mandatories: Follow the locked ten-panel storyboard exactly
End on NEVER MISS FIGHT NIGHT. and EXPLORE EVENTS
Declare every concept screen as PRODUCT_MOCKUP
